عَيَآءٌ An incurable disease; (K;) a difficult disease, for which there is no cure; as though it disabled, or baffled, (أَعْيَا,) the physicians. (S.) [Hence,] one says, الدَّآءُ العَيَآءُ الحُمْقُ [The disease for which there is no cure is stupidity]. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also عَيَايَآءُ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
